Specification: This module specifies a resolved timestamp mechanism over a set of region keys RM. It models region-local transaction message generation and application, forwarding of messages through a channel to a resolver, and production of resolved timestamps and commit timestamps into output queues. The specification includes transaction steps such as prewrite, commit, rollback, message application, fetch-ts requests, and resolver-side handling, and it verifies safety properties about commit timestamp consistency, resolved timestamp consistency, and overall type correctness; it also defines a liveness-style leads-to property showing that FetchTS messages can eventually produce a resolved timestamp when no region has an outstanding prewrite.
IfThenElse:
IF s = {} THEN 0
    ELSE CHOOSE n \in s: \A m \in s: n \leq m

IF s = {} THEN 0
    ELSE CHOOSE n \in s: \A m \in s: n \geq m

IF newResolvedTS # lastResolvedTS
            THEN /\ outputTSQueue' = Append(outputTSQueue, newResolvedTS)
                 /\ resolvedQueue' = Append(resolvedQueue,
                                                [ts |-> newResolvedTS,
                                                index |-> nextIndex + 1])
            ELSE UNCHANGED <<resolvedQueue, outputTSQueue>>

                                        ![r].pTS = t,
                                        ![r].msgs = Append(rmState[r].msgs,
                                                        [type |-> "Prewrite",
                                                         rm |-> r, ts |-> t])]

[rmState  EXCEPT  ![r].state = "committed",
                                        ![r].cTS = t,
                                        ![r].msgs = Append(rmState[r].msgs,
                                                        [type |-> "Commit",

LeadsToOp:
(/\ \A rm \in RM: /\ reState[rm].minPTS = 0
     /\ \E i \in 1..Len(chan): chan[i].type = "FetchTS" /\ i < chanOffset)
        ~> Len(resolvedQueue) # 0
